purpose: classify all 57 misses remaining after the frozen semantic-off nested-OOF policy and estimate the next mechanism's oracle ceiling

exclusive_classes_in_order.A_candidate_absent: target is absent from the frozen C100 pool on every causally eligible turn
exclusive_classes_in_order.C_admission_failure: target is C100-reachable and the frozen OOF ranker proposes it on at least one eligible turn, but the nested safe admission policy never activates that correct proposal
exclusive_classes_in_order.D_irrecoverable_ambiguous: target is C100-reachable, never correctly proposed, and every reachable turn has a target-blind evidence collision under the preregistered non-positional evidence projection with an equal-score competitor
exclusive_classes_in_order.B_ranker_failure: target is C100-reachable, is not an admission failure, and does not meet the strict ambiguity lower-bound definition

posthoc_boundary.target_use: labels, trace membership, class assignment, and aggregate oracle metrics only

required_aggregates: candidate recall C10/C20/C50/C100 and explicit C200 availability
class by scenario/query type and difficulty

decision_rule.oracle_bound_stop: C100 mechanical oracle or conservative distinguishable upper bound is below 0.99
decision_rule.next_experiment: preregister exactly one mechanism for the largest actionable class
